It's those little connections and shared experiences that make me feel included and appreciated.

On the other hand, spending time with just a few close friends is where I truly feel at ease. In smaller gatherings, I have the chance to open up more, share my thoughts and feelings without feeling self-conscious. The intimacy and depth of conversations in these settings are unparalleled. I cherish the ability to be myself and not worry about being judged or misunderstood.

In comparison, while large groups offer a diverse range of perspectives and opportunities for new friendships, they can also drain my energy. Small gatherings with close friends recharge me and provide a safe space for personal growth and emotional support. So, while both have their merits, I would say that spending time with a few close friends is more fulfilling for me as a shy individual.
